findings.description: The Southern Pacific Company bought the whole block, bounded by Fell, Baker, Hayes and Lyon Streets, for a new employees' hospital, in what was reported at the time as one of the largest land deals to follow that year's earthquake and fire. Its predecessor, opened in 1898 at Fourteenth and Mission Streets, had burned.
